messages:
hugo: Heads-up bringing up spectre9b-int4 on Dedicated canary. Hitting OOMs with bursty traffic when batch_size >= 10. Memory map shows many tiny free slots and KV cache growth.

meera: Can you share the canary config? especially prefetch/window and max_new_tokens defaults.

hugo: Canary config:
```
model: spectre9b-int4
batch_size: 10
max_new_tokens: 400
prefetch: 2
kv_prefetch: true
soft_reserve: 0.10
slot_compaction: background
```
This is what we typically used for 9b int variants.

jamal: Quick theory: int4 introduces many small temporary buffers during KV prefetch; with batch=10 we fragment freelist so compaction can't keep up. Two knobs to try: reduce batch to 6-8 and increase slot_compactor frequency/urgency. Also try kv_trim_interval=5s to evict cold KV earlier.

hugo: Kicked off two smokes: run-1 batch=8, prefetch=1; run-2 batch=10 but slot_compactor.aggr=high + kv_trim_interval=5s.

deploy-bot: deployment job #7219 started: canary-spectre9b-int4 -> pool-dedicated-7.

hugo: Run-1 after 25m: stable, fragmentation plateau ~60%, no OOMs, latency +6%. Run-2: still hit an OOM at 18m but fragmentation curve was shallower. slot_compactor helped but not enough under heavy long-seq mix.

meera: For quality: can you run the eval harness (200 long-context prompts, seeds attached) comparing int4 vs int8? If token-level divergence > 1% we hold. Also collect generation likelihood diffs.

jamal: Ops suggestion: add metric kv_alloc_rate and kv_eviction_count/min. If eviction spikes > X threshold, auto-fallback to int8 or route to large-memory hosts. I can draft the alert.

hugo: Agreed. I'll open a PR proposing per-model defaults: {"batch_size":"8", "max_new_tokens":"192", "prefetch":"1", "kv_trim_interval":"5s", "slot_compactor.aggr":"high"} and add the metrics + fallback rule.

deply-bot: (typo) sorry — noting job #7219 success at 30m.

meera: I'll run the eval and post diffs. If quality is acceptable and fragmentation stable, we can approve canary wave 2.

hugo: Action items: hugo PR with defaults + metrics; jamal alert rule + compactor patch; meera eval runs. Closing thread for now, will update with PR link and eval artifacts. :thumbsup:
